snippet.title: Sab Se Behtareen Khana Kaun Sa? Halaal Kamaai | Sahih Bukhari 2072 #shorts
snippet.description:
Sab se behtareen khana kaun sa hai? Mehanga hotel? Nahin!

Hazrat Miqdam (Radi Allahu Anhu) se riwayat hai ke Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) ne farmaya:
«مَا أَكَلَ أَحَدٌ طَعَامًا قَطُّ خَيْرًا مِنْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْ عَمَلِ يَدِهِ»
"Kisi ne kabhi apne haath ki kamaai se behtar khana nahin khaya. Aur Allah ke Nabi Hazrat Dawood (Alaihis Salam) apne haath ki kamaai se khaate thay."

Reference
• Sahih al-Bukhari 2072: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:2072

Mazdoor ho, dukaandaar ho, ya driver: halaal mehnat mein koi sharam nahin. Paseene ki har ek boond, jab halaal ho, to izzat hai. Aaj kaam par jaate hue niyyat karein: halaal rozi, ghar waalon ke liye. Comment mein likhein: Ya Allah, hamein halaal rizq ata farma! Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍

We never show any Prophet or Companion; only ordinary working people are drawn.
